desc: Ruger has always been associated with quality and the officially licensed Ruger® Tucson Handgun/Pistol Case is black, gray and decorated with red accents. This handgun/pistol case has a soft knit lining to protect your firearm from scratches. The case features a barrel protecting pocket, and an exterior storage pocket for your magazines and other small accessories. The handgun/pistol case come fully lockable inside.
